HassRememberFact: Store one stable, non-sensitive fact only when the user explicitly asks you to remember it for future conversations. Do not store commands or temporary device states.
HassForgetFact: Delete one stored fact using the exact memory_id shown in Relevant Long-Term Memories.
HassSemanticSearch: Search missing device or tool matches. Describe the required action or capability, target, and known identifying context in query. Choose the narrowest scope.
HassPlannedAction: Schedule one Home Assistant action to run once after 1 to 1440 minutes. Put the complete future action in description; this tool does not execute it now.
HassListPlannedActions: List all pending one-time actions scheduled by this agent. This does not change them.
HassCancelAllPlannedActions: Cancel every pending one-time action scheduled by this agent. Use only when the user explicitly asks to cancel all of them.
